The school board agreed to hold a proper public hearing and invite student input to rewrite the code.

Confusing WHAT (beverage rules) with WHO (procedural governance). Rules are weaponized without proper community consent.

The Unavoidable Truth: Rules require transparent public consent to hold moral legitimacy.

The Unavoidable Lie: Administrative convenience excuses bypassing public notice laws.
